templates.name: First outreach — vendor table + workshop
templates.subject: {{conference}} {{year}}: hardware vendor table + hands-on workshop from {{org}}
templates.body:
Hi {{conference}} team,

I'm {{me}} with {{org}}. We build and sell hands-on hardware hacking kits and run workshops at community security conferences (BSides, DEF CON villages, and similar).

For {{conference}} {{year}} ({{dates}}) we'd love to:
  • run a hands-on hardware workshop or mini-village, and
  • have a small vendor table for kits and badges.

Could you point me at the right person for vendor/sponsor tables and workshop proposals, or send the sponsor prospectus?

Thanks,
{{me}}
{{org}}

templates.name: Follow-up (no reply)
templates.subject: Re: {{conference}} {{year}}: vendor table + workshop from {{org}}

templates.name: Village / workshop proposal
templates.subject: {{conference}} {{year}} village proposal: hands-on hardware hacking
templates.body:
Hi {{conference}} organizers,

{{org}} would like to propose a hands-on hardware hacking village/workshop for {{conference}} {{year}}.

What we bring:
  • Guided hands-on exercises (soldering, firmware extraction, serial/JTAG, RF) sized for beginners through intermediate
  • All equipment and kits; we only need tables, power, and a corner of a room
  • Staff for the full event

We've run this format at [list a couple of cons]. Let me know what information you need for the village process.

Thanks,
{{me}}
{{org}}
